\section[(dialogue)]{Everyday actions — a first pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R109-first-pass-everyday-actions}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a needle and thread.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item courage, talent, a machine, equipment, a method
  \item cooking, to join, to fill, to burn, sewing
  \item to weave, to attach, to move aside, to wake someone, to save
  \item to get down, swimming, to jump, to hit, a share
  \item to measure, to stand, to lie down, closed, to wipe
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Courage? (\textbf{\bn{সাহস}}, \emph{sāhôs}.) Talent? (\textbf{\bn{প্রতিভা}}, \emph{prôtibhā}.) A machine? (\textbf{\bn{যন্ত্র}}, \emph{jôntrô}.) Equipment? (\textbf{\bn{সরঞ্জাম}}, \emph{sôrônjām}.) A method? (\textbf{\bn{পদ্ধতি}}, \emph{pôddhôti}.) Cooking? (\textbf{\bn{রান্না}}, \emph{rānnā}.) To join? (\textbf{\bn{জোড়া}}, \emph{jorā}.) To fill? (\textbf{\bn{ভরানো}}, \emph{bhôrāno}.) To burn? (\textbf{\bn{পোড়ানো}}, \emph{poṛāno}.) Sewing? (\textbf{\bn{সেলাই}}, \emph{selāi}.) To weave? (\textbf{\bn{বোনা}}, \emph{bonā}.) To attach? (\textbf{\bn{লাগানো}}, \emph{lāgāno}.) To move aside? (\textbf{\bn{সরানো}}, \emph{sôrāno}.) To wake someone? (\textbf{\bn{জাগানো}}, \emph{jāgāno}.) To save? (\textbf{\bn{বাঁচানো}}, \emph{bā̃chāno}.) To get down? (\textbf{\bn{নামা}}, \emph{nāmā}.) Swimming? (\textbf{\bn{সাঁতার}}, \emph{sā̃tār}.) To jump? (\textbf{\bn{লাফানো}}, \emph{lāphāno}.) To hit? (\textbf{\bn{মারা}}, \emph{mārā}.) A share? (\textbf{\bn{ভাগ}}, \emph{bhāg}.) To measure? (\textbf{\bn{মাপা}}, \emph{māpā}.) To stand? (\textbf{\bn{দাঁড়ানো}}, \emph{dā̃ṛāno}.) To lie down? (\textbf{\bn{শোয়া}}, \emph{shoyā}.) Closed? (\textbf{\bn{বন্ধ}}, \emph{bôndhô}.) To wipe? (\textbf{\bn{মোছা}}, \emph{mochhā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Things in the kitchen and the house — a second pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R109-second-pass-things-in-the-kitchen-and-the-house}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to dust and to tidy up.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to dust, to tidy up, to decorate, to fry, to mix
  \item to throw, to press, to draw, to return, to drive
  \item a bowl, a cooking pot, a wok, a water pot, a bucket
  \item a broom, a pillow, a sheet, a quilt, a mat
  \item a comb, soap, a thin towel, a needle, thread
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To dust? (\textbf{\bn{ঝাড়া}}, \emph{jhāṛā}.) To tidy up? (\textbf{\bn{গোছানো}}, \emph{gochhāno}.) To decorate? (\textbf{\bn{সাজানো}}, \emph{sājāno}.) To fry? (\textbf{\bn{ভাজা}}, \emph{bhājā}.) To mix? (\textbf{\bn{মেশানো}}, \emph{meshāno}.) To throw? (\textbf{\bn{ছোড়া}}, \emph{chhõṛā}.) To press? (\textbf{\bn{টেপা}}, \emph{ṭepā}.) To draw? (\textbf{\bn{আঁকা}}, \emph{ā̃kā}.) To return? (\textbf{\bn{ফেরা}}, \emph{pherā}.) To drive? (\textbf{\bn{চালানো}}, \emph{chālāno}.) A bowl? (\textbf{\bn{বাটি}}, \emph{bāṭi}.) A cooking pot? (\textbf{\bn{হাঁড়ি}}, \emph{hā̃ṛi}.) A wok? (\textbf{\bn{কড়াই}}, \emph{kôṛāi}.) A water pot? (\textbf{\bn{কলসি}}, \emph{kolsi}.) A bucket? (\textbf{\bn{বালতি}}, \emph{bālti}.) A broom? (\textbf{\bn{ঝাঁটা}}, \emph{jhā̃ṭā}.) A pillow? (\textbf{\bn{বালিশ}}, \emph{bālish}.) A sheet? (\textbf{\bn{চাদর}}, \emph{chādôr}.) A quilt? (\textbf{\bn{লেপ}}, \emph{lep}.) A mat? (\textbf{\bn{মাদুর}}, \emph{mādur}.) A comb? (\textbf{\bn{চিরুনি}}, \emph{chiruni}.) Soap? (\textbf{\bn{সাবান}}, \emph{sābān}.) A thin towel? (\textbf{\bn{গামছা}}, \emph{gāmchhā}.) A needle? (\textbf{\bn{সুই}}, \emph{sui}.) Thread? (\textbf{\bn{সুতো}}, \emph{sutô}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
